requirement.statement: Eidolon native workflow component SHALL provide Resource Type/Instance/Run and immutable Material lifecycles using canonical XNL/depa-flows resources and Eidolon actor/session effect authority.

case.given: a published workflow resource is instantiated and the publication is later changed
case.when: the instance is started or a prior run is recovered
case.then: execution SHALL use the instance's frozen content revision and form
it SHALL NOT resolve the current publication

case.given: a valid instance with input facts and bindings
case.when: start is requested without explicit execution confirmation
case.then: the component SHALL return a freeze preview without creating run facts, events, or effects

case.given: a caller-supplied run id and request fingerprint
case.when: the same start is repeated or input mutation is attempted after start
case.then: the same request SHALL return the existing run, conflicting reuse SHALL fail, and started instance inputs SHALL be immutable

case.given: a ctrl or data workflow has a pending human or agent wait handle
case.when: the handle is resolved/rejected or the runtime process is reconstructed
case.then: the exact pending handle SHALL transition through the existing Eidolon/depa-flows lifecycle and stable run facts SHALL recover status and result

case.given: a workspace-contained regular source file or directory
case.when: it is imported as a Material
case.then: the component SHALL create or reuse a content-addressed immutable revision with manifest and provenance
path escape and symlink traversal SHALL be rejected

case.given: an instance node port is bound to an exact Material revision
case.when: a confirmed run starts and produces outputs
case.then: its receipt SHALL retain exact input and output revisions and leases

case.given: a completed run receipt and a later binding to a different revision
case.then: the new run SHALL inherit the original receipt's exact revisions rather than current bindings

case.given: an export destination or cleanup candidate set
case.when: the operation is not confirmed or a revision remains leased
case.then: no filesystem export or leased revision deletion SHALL occur

case.given: conversation tools and eidolon workflow CLI expose lifecycle operations
case.when: they query or mutate workflow facts
case.then: both surfaces SHALL call the same workflow component service and SHALL NOT retain a direct-run or private-storage path

case.given: agent, tool, human, graph and Material execution evidence exists
case.then: the workflow store SHALL own only Type/Instance/Run/receipt facts while depa-flows and Eidolon retain their existing fact authority
